section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study examining the factor structure and psychometric properties of the Persian BAS-2 in Iran, conducted with 568 men and 525 women recruited from seven universities in Tehran (total N = 1093). The Persian BAS-2 showed a one-factor solution, satisfactory convergent validity and internal consistency, and men scored significantly higher than women; no ages, BMI, racial composition, survey method, or correlations with BMI are reported in the abstract.
section_summary.evidence_source: The present study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran. Participants were 568 men and 525 women from seven universities in Tehran, Iran. Similar to the original English version, the Persian BAS-2 had a one-factor solution. Persian BAS-2 scores had satisfactory convergent validity ... Men had significantly higher scores on BAS-2 compared to women.
